title: Agent 63 Authoritative Institutional Semantic Registry
description: Machine-readable catalog of institutional analytics metrics, dimensions, join paths, and security governance.

security_policy.policy_name: Agent 63 Semantic Security & Data Governance Policy
security_policy.description: Defines access tiers, strict confidentiality boundaries, protected demographic restrictions, and lifecycle governance for all institutional semantic models.

sensitivity_tiers.description: Public or general institutional metadata (e.g., campus details, department names, course catalogs, academic calendar).
Standard institutional operational metrics (e.g., aggregate attendance, course pass rates, grade distributions, CO/PO attainment, placement statistics).
Individual student marks, individual attendance records, placement CTC packages, faculty workload details. Must be role-scoped and aggregated where appropriate.
Disciplinary records, grievances, confidential exam preparation, identity authentication credentials. Strictly excluded from general institutional analytics.

confidential_domain_isolation.rationale: Medical notes, psychological counselling records, accommodation requests, and crisis escalation logs must never be mapped or queryable in Agent 63 under any circumstance.

placement_fairness_constraints.rationale: Constitutional and institutional placement fairness prohibits filtering, ranking, or discriminating candidates based on protected demographic traits.

approval_criteria: Grain and aggregation behavior explicitly defined
Null and zero division handling specified

dimensions.description: Institutional academic calendar cycle spanning instructional terms (e.g., 2024-2025).
Admission cohort of students pursuing a specific programme (e.g., 2022-2026 Batch).
Specific course version offering syllabus credits, lecture/practical hours, and passing norms.
Specific delivery instance of a course version assigned to a section and term.
Operating academic department (e.g., Computer Science & Engineering, Electronics & Communication).
Teaching and instructional faculty member identified by employee number and departmental affiliation.
Degree program offered by a department (e.g., B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering).
Instructional classroom cohort division within a batch (e.g., Section A, Section B).
Enrolled student entity identified by institutional roll number and assigned cohort.
Specific semester or trimester instructional period within an academic year.

join_paths.notes: Links calendar academic year to constituent terms.
Links parent institution to academic departments.
Links department to degree programmes offered.
Links degree programme to admission cohorts.
Links cohort batch to classroom sections.
Links catalog master course to regulation-specific course versions.
Links syllabus version to scheduled delivery instance.
Links instructional term to course offerings scheduled in that term.
Links section to dedicated course offering.
Links offering to registered student records.
Links student to enrolled course offerings.
Resolves student person details (name, gender).
Resolves faculty person details.
Links academic department to affiliated instructional faculty.
Connects offering to student attendance summaries.
Connects student to individual attendance records.
Links course offering to examination course results.
Links student to examination course results.
Maps course outcome to programme outcome articulation matrix.
Maps programme outcome to course outcomes.
Links candidate student to employment offers received.
Links recruiting company to offers issued.
Links student to computed placement readiness band and score.
Links IQAC KPI master definition to periodic evaluated values.

metrics.description: Total count of active enrolled students across academic departments, programmes, and cohorts.
Total count of scheduled course offerings actively delivered in an academic term.
metrics.validation_notes: Count of running course delivery sections.

metrics.description: Percentage of examined students who passed the course examination offering.
metrics.formula: round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE result_status = 'PASS') / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE result_status <> 'ABSENT'), 0), 2)

null_handling.zero_denominator: NULLIF(students_appeared, 0) yields NULL (prevents divide by zero when 0 students appeared)

metrics.validation_notes: Directly matches authoritative institutional view calculation.

metrics.description: Arithmetic mean of total marks scored by examined students in a course offering.
Total number of registered candidates who appeared for examination in a course offering.
Total number of candidates who secured a PASS result in a course offering.
Total number of candidates who appeared but failed to satisfy passing criteria.
Mean continuous internal assessment (CIA) marks computed across enrolled students in a course offering.

null_handling.zero_denominator: NULL if no internal marks submitted

metrics.validation_notes: CIA continuous evaluation marks before final external exam.

metrics.description: Average percentage of attended instructional sessions including approved duty/medical leave adjustments.

null_handling.missing_records: NULL (never convert missing enrollment or zero-held sessions to 0%)

metrics.validation_notes: Authoritative institutional view calculates adjusted_pct with DISTINCT ON latest as_of_date.

metrics.description: Direct session attendance percentage strictly based on physical classroom presence without leave adjustments.
metrics.validation_notes: Unadjusted presence metric derived from attendance.attendance_summary.

metrics.description: Count of distinct students whose adjusted attendance falls below institutional eligibility threshold (e.g. 75%).
metrics.provenance: Institutional academic regulations (75% statutory norm pending IQAC parameter configuration)
metrics.validation_notes: Threshold is policy-dependent. Metric kept in REVIEW_REQUIRED status until threshold parameter injection is approved.

metrics.description: Mean attendance percentage achieved across all registered students in a specific course offering.
Mean attendance percentage achieved across students enrolled in a classroom section.
metrics.provenance: attendance.v_current_attendance joined to academics.course_offering in schema_full.sql

metrics.description: Count of students classified in the institutional SHORTAGE band for examination condonation review.
Final evaluated attainment level (typically on a 0-3 scale) achieved for a Course Outcome in a course offering.
metrics.validation_notes: Authoritative final_level calculation blending direct and indirect attainment assessments.

metrics.description: Weighted attainment level evaluated for an NBA/ABET Programme Outcome (PO) across contributing courses.
metrics.validation_notes: Programme-level aggregation for NBA accreditation compliance.

metrics.description: Percentage of evaluated students who satisfied the threshold rubric score for a specific Course Outcome.
Correlation weight (1: Low, 2: Moderate, 3: High) between Course Outcome and Programme Outcome in curricular matrix.
Count of unique graduating students who have received and accepted at least one verified employment offer.
metrics.validation_notes: Distinguishes distinct placed students from total offer count to account for multi-offer recipients.

metrics.description: Aggregate count of all verified employment offers issued across participating recruitment companies.
Mean annual Cost to Company (CTC) compensation package for verified placement offers.
Maximum annual CTC compensation offer secured by any student in the cohort.
Proportion of graduating eligible students who secured verified placement.
metrics.provenance: Institutional placement cell policy & NIRF guidelines
metrics.validation_notes: Denominator cohort selection requires resolution: whether opted-out, higher-education, or backlog-restricted students are included in denominator.

metrics.description: Mean overall placement readiness assessment score (0-100) evaluated across students preparing for campus recruitment.
metrics.validation_notes: Composite readiness score evaluated across technical, soft skills, and aptitude.

metrics.display_name: Official IQAC KPI Latest Measured Value
metrics.description: Latest periodic value measured for an officially approved institutional KPI definition.

null_handling.missing_records: NULL (do not substitute 0 for unmeasured KPI)

metrics.provenance: quality.v_kpi_latest view & quality.kpi_definition table in schema_full.sql
metrics.validation_notes: Preserves official IQAC institutional KPI definitions without conflicting mathematical reinterpretation.

metrics.description: Percentage variance of latest measured KPI value against the institutional target benchmark.

null_handling.zero_denominator: NULL if target_value is 0 or undefined
